_note: 學習路徑內容第20批 #2／6：關係代名詞 which（eng.t_mid.relcl.which，會考級／中階）。which 指物（或動物），不指人（人用 who）；which 可用於限定子句，也可用於逗號後的非限定子句（不像 that）；which 當受詞時在限定子句可省略（the song (which) we like）；非限定子句的 which 還能回指前面整句（She passed, which made her happy.）。誘答鎖『who 指人／that 不用於逗號後／受詞省略後重複加 it／what 接名詞後』等唯一正解；禮物等無生命物不擬人故 who 在該題確為錯，不誇大。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix rlw_）。

units.title_zh: 關係代名詞 which（指物、限定與非限定）
units.can_do: 我能用 which 指物把句子接起來，知道 which 指物不指人、可用於限定子句也可用於逗號後的非限定子句、當受詞時可省略，也能用非限定的 which 回指前面整句。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'which' is a relative pronoun for things (and animals), not people; for people we use who: 'the book which I read', 'the dog which barks'.
claims.verification_ref: which 指物（或動物），人用 who（the book which I read）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'which' is used in both defining clauses and non-defining clauses (after a comma); unlike 'that', 'which' can follow a comma: 'My bike, which is new, is fast.'
claims.verification_ref: which 可用於限定子句與逗號後的非限定子句；that 不用於逗號後（My bike, which is new, is fast）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When 'which' is the object of a defining clause it can be left out, and the clause does not repeat the object with a pronoun: 'the gift (which) she gave me'.
claims.verification_ref: 限定子句中 which 當受詞可省略（the gift (which) she gave me）；省略後不再用 it 重複受詞；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In a non-defining clause, 'which' can refer back to the whole previous clause: 'She won first prize, which surprised everyone.'
claims.verification_ref: 非限定子句的 which 可回指前面整句（She won first prize, which surprised everyone）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'which' points to a thing (or an animal), not a person. For people we use who. This is the phone which takes great photos. which 指物（人要用 who）。
This is the phone which takes great photos.
teach.zh_hint: 這是拍照很棒的手機。which 指物 phone。

teach.body: 'which' works in a defining clause (no commas) and also after a comma in a non-defining clause — where 'that' is not used. My school, which is near the park, is big. 逗號後的補充說明用 which，不用 that。
My school, which is near the park, is big.
teach.zh_hint: 我的學校在公園附近，很大。逗號後用 which 補充說明。

teach.body: When 'which' is the object, you can leave it out: the song (which) we like. After a comma, 'which' can also refer back to the whole idea. He missed the bus, which made him late. which 當受詞可省略；逗號後的 which 可回指整件事。
He missed the bus, which made him late.
teach.zh_hint: 他沒搭到公車，這件事使他遲到。which 回指『沒搭到公車』整件事。

practice.stem: 選正確：This is the key ____ opens the front door.（這是開前門的鑰匙）

distractor_rationales.who: who 指人，這裡 key 是物。
distractor_rationales.whom: whom 是指人的受格，不用於物。
distractor_rationales.whose: whose 表所有（某人的…），這裡不是所有關係。

practice.feedback: the key which opens…：which 指物、限定是哪一把鑰匙。

practice.stem: 選正確：My bike, ____ is new, goes very fast.（我的腳踏車是新的，跑得很快）

distractor_rationales.that: 逗號後的非限定子句不用 that，指物要用 which。
distractor_rationales.who: who 指人，這裡 bike 是物。
distractor_rationales.what: what 不接在名詞 bike 後面當關係代名詞。

practice.feedback: My bike, which is new…：逗號後的補充說明用 which。

practice.stem: 選正確：She won first prize, ____ surprised everyone.（她得了第一名，這件事讓大家很驚訝）

distractor_rationales.that: that 不用於逗號後、也不能回指前面整句這種用法。
distractor_rationales.what: what 不引導這種補充說明整句的子句。
distractor_rationales.who: who 指人，這裡回指的是『得第一名』這件事，不是人。

practice.feedback: …, which surprised everyone：非限定的 which 回指前面整句。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（限定子句中 which 當受詞可省略）
practice.answer: The movie we watched was great.
options: The movie we watched was great.
The movie we watched it was great.
The movie what we watched was great.
The movie who we watched was great.

which 當受詞省略後，子句裡不再用 it 重複受詞。
名詞 movie 後面不用 what 當關係代名詞。
who 指人，這裡 movie 是物。

practice.feedback: The movie (which) we watched…：which 當受詞可省略，且不加 it。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（which 指物）
practice.answer: The gift which she gave me is lovely.
options: The gift which she gave me is lovely.
The gift which she gave me it is lovely.
The gift who she gave me is lovely.
The gift what she gave me is lovely.

which 當受詞後，子句裡不再用 it 重複受詞。
who 指人，這裡 gift（禮物）是物。
名詞 gift 後面不用 what 當關係代名詞。

practice.feedback: The gift which she gave me…：which 指物（禮物）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The house, which was very old, had a big garden.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：逗號、which、was、garden 有沒有拼對，兩個逗號有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。限定子句一氣呵成；非限定子句的逗號處稍停。

lines.text: This is the song which I love most.
lines.intonation: 平穩、句尾 most 下收

lines.text: He lost his keys, which was a big problem.
lines.intonation: keys 後稍停、句尾 problem 下收
